articles.title: Seoul district prepares to bring pet funerals directly to residents' doors
articles.description: Courier scooters in Seoul deliver everything from midnight kimchi stew to designer handbags in under an hour, and soon grieving pet owners in the city's east will be able to summon a hearse just as easily. articles.title: Why are young Koreans falling for Japanese animated series 'Chiikawa?'
articles.description: "I'm worried everything will sell out. They'll keep restocking, right?" A long line of customers stretched outside the Chiikawa Shop on the third floor of I'Park Mall in Yongsan District, Seoul, Nov. 5. A quick count put the number of people waiting at well over 50. They had come to buy merchandise featuring characters from the Japanese animated series "Chiikawa."
